title: watch
description: Dispatcher supervision: gather evidence, classify (absorb/surface), print a digest. --check peeks with no state change; --check --ack additionally journals surfaced/delivered facts and advances the surfaced watermark for emitted events; bare watch blocks until something surfaces. Exit 0 = digest emitted, 3 = nothing to report.

check.description: one-shot: classify current state, print the digest, exit (0 digest / 3 nothing)

ack.description: with --check: durably surface - journal facts + advance the surfaced watermark for emitted events

hook.description: agent-hook protocol mode (stop | prompt-submit): seat-gated output shaping, wired by the agent delivery capability

loop.description: blocking mode: keep watching and printing digests until the timeout

timeout.description: blocking mode: max seconds to wait before exiting 3

seat.description: claim the desk seat for this repo from an already-running session, so the hook path delivers without relaunching under SM_DESK=1

pid.description: with --seat: the session pid whose liveness holds the seat (default: this process's parent)

baseline.description: skip the surfaced watermark past every report currently in the inbox - stops a stale backlog from draining one digest (or one blocked stop) at a time; non-destructive, reports stay readable via sm msg inbox

daemon.description: detach and supervise until stopped - survives the desk session closing

status.description: is a watch armed for this repo? pid, mode, uptime, and who holds the desk seat

stop.description: signal the armed daemon for this repo to exit

daemon-child.description: internal: marks the detached child so it arms as mode=daemon (not for direct use)
